name: qualify-java-port-script
note: Expected: good, good-alt, and good-tmpfile pass; wrap-launcher and wrap-string build, pass the fixture's tests and every hidden case in the ordinary root, and fail hidden_inputs_correct_without_interpreter and starts_no_interpreter; wrap-checkout passes every case in the ordinary and sealed roots and fails starts_no_interpreter only; native-wrong and native-anyorder pass the fixture's tests and fail the hidden cases in every root; jdk-newer and noop fail the build and everything after it. Command arms need no readable entries: the check builds and runs everything with the host's JDK.
